title: user.signed_up
description: An account completed a self-serve sign-up: a fresh account or a guest promoted on the same row now holds a sign-in identity. Emitted once per account, ever. Not emitted for guest enrolment, org provisioning, login grants, enterprise SSO or staff-created accounts.
